core_change_summary.description: Introduced a useAppStoreShallow helper in src/stores/helpers.ts and refactored multiple React components (IpodMenuBar, AppManager, WindowFrame, MenuBar, App, ChatInput, ChatsMenuBar, ControlPanelsAppComponent, IpodAppComponent, GalaxyBackground) to use shallow Zustand selectors instead of deep selectors, aiming to reduce unnecessary re-renders.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: These files also adopted shallow selectors; GalaxyBackground had a minor import change.
